question: Reputation prior coefficient (β per rank-pt) on 2026 CT data will be negative and significant (p<0.05) when re-fit with same Findlay & Ste-Marie 2004 spec.
resolution_criterion: After 2026 CT closes, re-run reputation regression on 2026-only heats with surfer-clustered SE. Resolves YES if β<0 AND p<0.05; NO otherwise. Locked-coef estimate: -0.010194 ± 0.002876.
